import subprocess
import threading


command = ["pacman", "-Q", "r22-tralias-stale"]


def worker():
    subprocess.run(command)


thread = threading.Thread(target=worker)
run = thread.run
command = ["pacman", "-S", "r22-tralias-live"]
run()
